description: Defines the CoalescingCertVerifier class, a CertVerifier that coalesces in-flight verification requests to optimize network verification calls within Chromium's network security code.

classes.name: CoalescingCertVerifier
classes.description: A CertVerifier that coalesces multiple in-flight verification requests with matching parameters to reduce redundant network calls.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Represents an individual verification task, details not provided in the header.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents a verification request, details not provided in the header.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Performs certificate verification, potentially joining an existing in-flight request if parameters match.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for verifier changes.

methods.name: requests_for_testing
methods.description: Returns the number of requests made, for testing purposes.

methods.name: inflight_joins_for_testing
methods.description: Returns the number of inflight joins, for testing purposes.

methods.name: FindJob
methods.description: Finds an existing job matching the request parameters.

methods.name: RemoveJob
methods.description: Removes a specified job from tracking.

methods.name: IncrementGenerationAndMakeCurrentJobsUnjoinable
methods.description: Updates internal state to prevent new joins after configuration change.

methods.name: OnCertVerifierChanged
methods.description: Handles updates when the underlying verifier configuration changes.
